_Tipping Study - pt.4 Demarcate movements_
---

###### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)

load(here::here("data", "proc", "03_out.rdata"))
```

> [!Note]
> At this point columns for individual markers are superfluous.

```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "03_out.rdata"))
dt[, (grep("^m\\d", colnames(dt))) := NULL]
```


Define movement bounds
---


> [!Note]
> Each trial began with a 300ms go-period, which works out to 36 frames at 120 Hz.
> To be safe, backing it down a few.
>
> Re-normalizing to center on position at first (remaining) frame.
> Don't know if this is correct to do.

```{r}
dt <- dt[rel_frame >= 30]

# Get column indices describing hand position
translate <- grep("^hand", colnames(dt))

dt[,
  # re-normalize by subtracting initial position
  (translate) := lapply(.SD, \(xyz) xyz <- xyz - xyz[1]),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num),
  .SDcols = translate
]

# While we're at it, re-normalize time as well
dt[, rel_frame := seq_len(.N), by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)]
dt[, time := rel_frame / 120]

pclid(dt$hand_z, braille = TRUE) # Looks good, peaks at 0 & 35
```

> Get 3d vector velocity from positional data.

```{r}
hand_cols <- grep("^hand", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

# create cols for moment-to-moment positional shifts
dt[,
  # cols named delta_hand_[xyz]
  (paste0("delta_", hand_cols)) :=
    lapply(
      .SD,
      # get single-lagged differences
      \(col) col - shift(col, n = 1, type = "lag")
    ),
  .SDcols = hand_cols
]

# get velocity
dt[,
  velocity := sqrt(rowSums(.SD^2)) / (1 / 120),
  .SDcols = paste0("delta_", hand_cols)
]

# delete delta cols
dt[, (grep("^delta_", colnames(dt))) := NULL]
```

> Smooth velocity values

```{r}
require(gsignal)

filt_order <- 4
samp <- 120
cutoff <- 10
nyq <- samp / 2
wn <- cutoff / nyq

buttbutt <- gsignal::butter(
  n = filt_order, w = wn, type = "low", output = "Sos"
)

dt[
  2:.N, # Fails if first row (NA) is included
  velocity := gsignal::filtfilt(buttbutt, velocity),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)
]

pclid(dt$velocity[2:nrow(dt)], braille = TRUE)
summary(dt$velocity[2:nrow(dt)], digits = 2)
```

> Create run length column counting consecutive rows wherein velocity >= 20 mm/s
> Movement start defined as the first of four consequtive rows threshold is met.

```{r}
movement_bounds <- dt[,
  # Consider movement if velocity >= 20 mm/s
  .(moving = as.numeric(velocity >= 20)),
  keyby = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
] |>
  _[,
    # Get run lengths of "movement"
    runs := frollsum(moving, n = 4, align = "right"),
    keyby = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
  ] |>
  _[,
    # Take the first instance of a length 4 run
    .(start = which.max(runs == 4)),
    keyby = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
  ]

pclid(movement_bounds$start, braille = TRUE)
summary(movement_bounds$start, digits = 0)
```

> Movement end defined as the first when z_position is maximal.

```{r}
movement_bounds$end <- dt[,
  # returns first index where hand_z == max(hand_z)
  .(end = which.max(hand_z)),
  keyby = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
] |> _[, end]
```

> Using bounds, clip data

```{r}
dt <- dt[
  # merge in bounds
  movement_bounds,
  on = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
] |>
  # from merged data
  _[,
    # only keep frames between start and end
    .SD[rel_frame %between% c(unique(start), unique(end))],
    by = .(participant_id, block_num, trial_num)
  ] |>
  # no longer needed
  _[, c("start", "end") := NULL]
```
